Description: Meridian is an east Mississippi regional center and rail-crossroads city near Naval Air Station Meridian, one of the Navy's jet strike pilot-training bases. It offers very low typical home values, an in-city VA outpatient clinic, Mississippi's military-retirement tax exemption, Walmart access, and arts anchors such as the Mississippi Arts + Entertainment Experience. Tradeoffs include high 2025 reported violent crime, hot humid summers, no local Costco, and a county-level conservative political baseline.
